title: JUICE: Unified Multimodal Modeling in Pretrained Representation Spaces
title_zh: JUICE：预训练表示空间中的统一多模态建模

paragraphs.en: JUICE在冻结编码器连续表示空间中用单一流匹配Transformer统一建模图文联合分布，图像生成与联合任务表现优异。 Most unified multimodal models treat images and text asymmetrically: a pretrained language model generates text, an attached diffusion head generates images, and outputs that contain both are produced in a fixed order, so the first output cannot adapt to the second. We ask whether both modalities can instead be generated by one process that is trained on them jointly from scratch. Pretrained encoder spaces hold both modalities in one continuous form and carry knowledge learned at scale, and recent work finds them effective as generative targets for vision and language. We therefore model the joint distribution directly in these spaces. We introduce JUICE (Joint Unified multimodal modeling In Continuous Encoder spaces), a single flow matching Transformer over frozen image and text representations, in which each modality has its own noise level. Which modalities are clean and which are generated then decides the task: image generation, captioning, visual question answering, or joint generation. Controlled pretraining runs test each design choice. At equal guidance, generating text as continuous states leaves image generation intact (48.41 GenEval, against 47.86 for a model trained only for text-to-image generation), while captions lose some exact wording. Training on joint and conditional denoising together beats either alone, and semantic encoder spaces beat VAE latents and raw pixels as targets. At 2.1B parameters, with no language model initialization and at 224x224, JUICE reaches up to 0.88 on GenEval and 73.1 on VQAv2. By sampling both modalities from the joint distribution (coupled sampling), it can also draw a route on a map while writing out the matching moves. On mazes with several valid solutions, joint success rises from 54.6% with independent sampling to 93.7%, and no modality has to go first. On visual spatial planning, JUICE solves 99.8% of maps at its training sizes.
paragraphs.zh: JUICE在冻结编码器连续表示空间中用单一流匹配Transformer统一建模图文联合分布，图像生成与联合任务表现优异。大多数统一多模态模型对图像和文本的处理是不对称的：预训练语言模型生成文本，附加的扩散头生成图像，同时包含两者的输出以固定顺序产生，因此第一个输出无法适应第二个输出。 我们探究是否可以改为用一个从零开始在两种模态上联合训练的单一过程来生成两种模态。 预训练编码器空间以一种连续形式同时容纳两种模态，并携带大规模学习到的知识，近期工作发现它们作为视觉和语言的生成目标十分有效。 因此我们直接在这些空间中建模联合分布。 我们提出JUICE（连续编码器空间中的联合统一多模态建模），这是一个作用于冻结图像和文本表示的单一流匹配Transformer，其中每种模态拥有自己的噪声水平。 哪些模态是干净的、哪些需要生成，便决定了任务：图像生成、图像描述、视觉问答或联合生成。 受控的预训练实验检验了每一项设计选择。 在相同引导强度下，以连续状态生成文本不会损害图像生成（GenEval为48.41，对比仅用文本到图像生成训练的模型的47.86），但描述会丢失一些精确措辞。 联合去噪与条件去噪一起训练优于单独使用其中任何一种，且语义编码器空间作为目标优于VAE潜在表示和原始像素。 在21亿参数、无语言模型初始化、224x224分辨率下，JUICE在GenEval上最高达到0.88，在VQAv2上达到73.1。 通过从联合分布中采样两种模态（耦合采样），它还能在地图上绘制路线的同时写出对应的走法。 在有多个有效解的迷宫上，联合成功率从独立采样的54.6%提升到93.7%，且不需要任何模态先行。 在视觉空间规划任务上，JUICE在其训练尺寸的地图上解决了99.8%的问题。
